findings.claim: The tightened blocking `os-locations-only-via-platform` check is committed while it is known to match four existing repository violations, so the blocking gate cannot be clean.
findings.evidence: The hunk changes the check to `-e "node:os" -- "lib/*.mjs" "scripts/*.mjs" ...`; the added correction table and note state the corrected check reports `convert-htmx-pdf.mjs:18`, `design-svg-logo.mjs:36`, `hook-cold-start.mjs:13`, and `refine-moodboard.mjs:45`. The constraints command policy says a match is a violation and blocking constraints prevent archiving until resolved.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the four `scripts/` violations to use `lib/platform/paths.mjs` helpers before tightening the blocking check, or explicitly scope them out in the check with a documented exclusion that still discriminates.

findings.claim: The change adds a new ownership-policy rule to `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md`, which changes are not authorized to do.
findings.evidence: The path ownership table says `.kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md` rules and thresholds are `/kbd-init` owned and that a change never loosens, deletes or adds a RULE; the diff adds a new row for `check:` expressions, `TIGHTENED`, defining when such edits are permitted.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not modify the governance rule in this change; have `/kbd-init` update the constraints policy, or keep this change limited to check-expression edits already authorized by the existing policy.
